programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #1
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #2
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #1
programme.desc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #3
programme.desc: 動物嬰兒: 為了嬰兒免受極端情況、飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #4
programme.desc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一。從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #5
programme.desc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #1
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #2
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #1
programme.desc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #2
programme.desc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #3
programme.desc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #6
programme.desc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報。動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙。牠們必須學習覓食、保護家園、吸引配偶、養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #7
programme.desc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #8
programme.desc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #9
programme.desc: 爬行動物、兩棲動物、昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落——而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #10
programme.desc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰。這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道。

programme.title: 納萊迪: 小象故事
programme.desc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。

programme.title: 下一站: 緬甸
programme.desc: 《下一站: 緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #1
programme.desc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #2
programme.desc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #3
programme.desc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #4
programme.desc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #5
programme.desc: 人類、植物、動物、細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點: 死亡。我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #1
programme.desc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭。變髒是工作的一部分。當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務。這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人。而且,總能忙裡偷閒。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #3
programme.desc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物。深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就。還有,努力無堅不摧。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #4
programme.desc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成、新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #5

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #7

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海。探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #3
programme.desc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統。在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活。

programme.title: 大白鯊的秘密

programme.title: 動物長青術 #2

programme.title: 動物長青術 #4
programme.desc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #5
programme.desc: 人類、植物、動物、細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點: 死亡。我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #1
programme.desc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #2

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #4

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2

programme.title: 侏羅紀公園
programme.desc: 一位工業家邀請一些專家參觀他的複製恐龍主題樂園。一場停電讓這些生物逃了出來,危及所有人的性命,當中還包括他的孫兒。

programme.title: 迷走星球
programme.desc: 年輕的兩兄弟的房子神奇地衝入太空,他們繼而被捲入一場星際冒險。

programme.title: 小子難纏 2
programme.desc: 宮城先生得知父親快要死去,遂帶上丹尼爾一起去探望他。他回去後決定迎戰老對手;同時,丹尼爾無意中亦招惹了敵人。

programme.title: 雙龍會
programme.desc: 一對從小失散的同卵雙胞胎——一位是居住在紐約的音樂家,另一位是生活在香港的技工——多年後因音樂家的演奏會行程來到香港,意外重逢,引發一連串錯綜有趣的事件。

programme.title: 世界大對戰
programme.desc: 在這場視覺上壯觀的動作冒險遊戲中,一群意想不到的前 80 年代電子遊戲冠軍挺身而出,拯救世界免於外星人入侵。

programme.title: 新郎不是我
programme.desc: 一個愛上已訂婚女人的男人,在她邀請自己成為她的伴娘後試圖贏得她的芳心。

programme.title: 邁阿密風雲
programme.desc: 在《邁阿密風雲》中,由傑米・福克斯與柯林・法洛飾演的臥底警探深入毒品世界,在危險、誘惑與犯罪中周旋。這部風格鮮明、緊張刺激的作品重新演繹經典影集,同時由鞏俐聯袂主演。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #99

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #1
programme.desc: 喜歡強者,對弱者沒興趣的孤獨不良高中生櫻遙,為了爬上不良學校風鈴高中的頂點,從鎮「外」來到這裡。櫻在商店街從混混手中救下的少女琴葉,請他到波特斯咖啡廳吃飯作為報答,卻直言他無法爬上頂點。氣憤的櫻在隨後了解到她話中的真意及「風鈴的現狀」。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #22
programme.desc: 在出發前往宮崎前,阿奎亞與佳奈一同出門購物。在阿奎亞周到的安排下,佳奈開心得手足無措…。另一方面,失去揪出父親這個目標的阿奎亞則是向小茜坦白說出…

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #23
programme.desc: 睽違10多年,阿奎亞再度踏上過去吾郎與紗理奈生活過、亦是阿奎亞與露比的出生之地的宮崎,阿奎亞回顧著吾郎的人生軌跡。另一方面,心裡一直深藏對吾郎心意的露比卻…。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #98
programme.desc: 進入研究室的亞連和書人與無數惡魔交戰。然而亞連最終被接二連三出現的惡魔擋住去路,書人則被黏至牆壁並遭結晶化。在這段期間,露露貝爾偷走了卵,同伴們接連犧牲。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #99
programme.desc: 元帥們以壓倒性的力量將惡魔們一網打盡,接著他們試圖摧毀「卵」。米蘭達卻因為突然被關在由地面噴出的水柱中而痛苦掙扎。而這道來歷不明的水柱在震驚的眾人面前化為一名女子的模樣。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #4
programme.desc: 快跑啊!超可愛的貓咪來了!時間來到21世紀某時期,全世界都被貓咪佔據,有一種病毒會把接觸到貓的人都變成貓,讓全世界爆發貓化大流行,人只要被貓蹭過就會變成貓。人類究竟能否壓抑住想摸貓的衝動,在滿是貓咪的世界中存活下來呢?

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #1
programme.desc: 喜歡強者,對弱者沒興趣的孤獨不良高中生櫻遙,為了爬上不良學校風鈴高中的頂點,從鎮「外」來到這裡。櫻在商店街從混混手中救下的少女琴葉,請他到波特斯咖啡廳吃飯作為報答,卻直言他無法爬上頂點。氣憤的櫻在隨後了解到她話中的真意及「風鈴的現狀」。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.desc: 突然出現在亞連面前的林克監察官表示自己是奉教團之命前來監視。亞連對林克所說的話感到動搖,他透過玻璃窗戶看到奏者的影子映照在自己身後。另一邊,利娜莉遇到魯貝里亞,童年記憶因此被喚醒。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #97
programme.desc: 科學班的成員陸續遭偽裝成安東尼的露露貝爾和無數惡魔不斷襲擊。亞連一行人察覺到惡魔的存在後趕往研究室,卻因為大門被堵住而無法進入。對方的目標是否就是工廠的「卵」?

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #98
programme.desc: 進入研究室的亞連和書人與無數惡魔交戰。然而亞連最終被接二連三出現的惡魔擋住去路,書人則被黏至牆壁並遭結晶化。在這段期間,露露貝爾偷走了卵,同伴們接連犧牲。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #99
programme.desc: 元帥們以壓倒性的力量將惡魔們一網打盡,接著他們試圖摧毀「卵」。米蘭達卻因為突然被關在由地面噴出的水柱中而痛苦掙扎。而這道來歷不明的水柱在震驚的眾人面前化為一名女子的模樣。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #100
programme.desc: 等級4的惡魔最終還是誕生了,亞連目睹被其當成內臟的人類靈魂,已不成人形的樣子使他不忍直視。他為了拯救靈魂而對等級4的惡魔發動攻擊,但招式全都被閃避。對方壓倒性的強大力量使亞連持劍的手開始顫抖。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #1
programme.desc: 為了抗衡來自天界的攻勢,惡魔「阿久津雅虎」前來人間尋找具備領袖特質、能拯救魔界的人才。他隱藏自己的真實身份,轉學至某所高中就讀並遇到了可愛的美少女「天音莉莉」。阿久津認為她可能就是能拯救魔界的「人類」,於是便向她提出邀約,然而……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #2
programme.desc: 阿久津被莉莉制服並成為了她的僕人,被迫協助她狩獵惡魔。阿久津拒絕協助,並表示他寧願被淨化也不願殺死自己的同類。於是莉莉便啟動了套在阿久津頸上的「奪走自由並施以懲罰的頸圈的力量」。然後,阿久津的身體就不由自主地開始動了起來……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #3
programme.desc: 阿久津帥氣地救出了在街上被搭訕的莉莉。儘管對遲到的阿久津感到生氣,兩人卻依舊直接前往約會……不,是前往狩獵惡魔。莉莉懷疑最近頻繁發生的野犬襲擊事件是惡魔的所為,於是她便和阿久津一同在街道中展開探索。然而,卻有一道殺氣騰騰的目光正注視著他們。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #4
programme.desc: 莉莉遇到了獸型惡魔,並與其展開了激烈的戰鬥。阿久津因夾在同族與莉莉之間而陷入兩難,他為了想辦法平息事態而介入了他們的戰鬥。然而,同族卻將阿久津視為叛徒,而莉莉則警告阿久津不要妨礙她,不然就將他給淨化。這時,被逼到絕境的阿久津思考出了一個辦法。

programme.title: 重啟人生的千金小姐正在攻略龍帝陛下 #7
programme.desc: 「軍神千金」吉兒被未婚夫王太子傑拉爾德陷害入獄並因此喪命,但回過神來竟發現自己回到與未婚夫初見的那晚。為了避開人生最糟選擇,吉兒決定要與未來的暴君,實則純真的鄰國皇帝哈迪斯結婚,並立志要幫他重新做人。重啟人生的千金,她的大逆轉劇就此開幕。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #3
programme.desc: 以打架聞名的強者全聚集在一年一班。無視於一旁慌張的榆井及冷靜旁觀的蘇枋隼飛,櫻與被他惹怒的杉下京太郎展開了一場豪邁的戰鬥。但防風鈴的總長梅宮一高分貝的聲音打斷了他們的攻防。當櫻等人神情緊張地仰望著擴音器時,等到的卻是梅宮出乎意料的一番話。

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #1
programme.desc: 魔法使少女「伊多拉阿波羅」每天在宅邸中替冒險者進行試煉,然而結果總是令人失望。就在此時,被譽為期待新星的「淺垣燈悟」現身了。他那神秘又俐落的動作和姿勢究竟會展現出怎麼樣的實力?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #2
programme.desc: 與伊多拉締結羈絆的淺垣燈悟前往冒險者公會登錄戰隊。而就在這時,伊多拉卻遭到冒險者辱罵,因為她那位曾是王家之杖卻被稱為「膽小鬼」的父親。就在衝突一觸即發之際,燈悟竟提議要用任務來一決勝負?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #3
programme.desc: 阿瓦魯羅斯特帝國的王女「蒂露緹娜」及侍從「羅吉米斯特」前來拜訪。他們請伊多拉協助分析及回收「魔力之種」,但羅吉似乎不願讓燈悟同行。結果兩人竟要透過戰鬥展現各自的實力?

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #3
programme.desc: 以打架聞名的強者全聚集在一年一班。無視於一旁慌張的榆井及冷靜旁觀的蘇枋隼飛,櫻與被他惹怒的杉下京太郎展開了一場豪邁的戰鬥。但防風鈴的總長梅宮一高分貝的聲音打斷了他們的攻防。當櫻等人神情緊張地仰望著擴音器時,等到的卻是梅宮出乎意料的一番話。

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #1
programme.desc: 魔法使少女「伊多拉阿波羅」每天在宅邸中替冒險者進行試煉,然而結果總是令人失望。就在此時,被譽為期待新星的「淺垣燈悟」現身了。他那神秘又俐落的動作和姿勢究竟會展現出怎麼樣的實力?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #2
programme.desc: 與伊多拉締結羈絆的淺垣燈悟前往冒險者公會登錄戰隊。而就在這時,伊多拉卻遭到冒險者辱罵,因為她那位曾是王家之杖卻被稱為「膽小鬼」的父親。就在衝突一觸即發之際,燈悟竟提議要用任務來一決勝負?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #3
programme.desc: 阿瓦魯羅斯特帝國的王女「蒂露緹娜」及侍從「羅吉米斯特」前來拜訪。他們請伊多拉協助分析及回收「魔力之種」,但羅吉似乎不願讓燈悟同行。結果兩人竟要透過戰鬥展現各自的實力?

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #4
programme.desc: 快跑啊!超可愛的貓咪來了!時間來到21世紀某時期,全世界都被貓咪佔據,有一種病毒會把接觸到貓的人都變成貓,讓全世界爆發貓化大流行,人只要被貓蹭過就會變成貓。人類究竟能否壓抑住想摸貓的衝動,在滿是貓咪的世界中存活下來呢?

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #23
programme.desc: 睽違10多年,阿奎亞再度踏上過去吾郎與紗理奈生活過、亦是阿奎亞與露比的出生之地的宮崎,阿奎亞回顧著吾郎的人生軌跡。另一方面,心裡一直深藏對吾郎心意的露比卻…。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #24
programme.desc: 復仇已然結束,吾郎屍首也已尋獲。一直以來為了利用小茜而將她留在身邊的這層關係,阿奎亞將會給出何種答案…。另一方面,露比遇見一名神秘少女,得知了事件的某些情報…!?

programme.title: 噬血狂襲 FINAL #4
programme.desc: MAR因最終王牌的眷獸彈頭被封住而使出強硬手段,召喚複數大型魔獸,開始侵略絃神島。潛入異境的古城與雪菜和奧蘿菈等人會合後,揭穿摩怪的真實身分以及其宏大的計畫。夏夫里亞爾暗中想取古城的性命,於是試圖狙撃,挺身保護古城的雪菜卻因此受傷。

programme.desc: MAR因最終王牌的眷獸彈頭被封住而使出強硬手段,召喚複數大型魔獸,開始侵略絃神島。潛入異境的古城與雪菜和奧蘿菈等人會合後,揭穿摩怪的真實身分以及其宏大的計畫。夏夫里亞爾暗中想取古城的性命,於是試圖狙撃,挺身保護古城的雪菜卻因此受傷。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #4
programme.desc: 快跑啊!超可愛的貓咪來了!時間來到21世紀某時期,全世界都被貓咪佔據,有一種病毒會把接觸到貓的人都變成貓,讓全世界爆發貓化大流行,人只要被貓蹭過就會變成貓。人類究竟能否壓抑住想摸貓的衝動,在滿是貓咪的世界中存活下來呢?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #1
programme.desc: 魔法使少女「伊多拉阿波羅」每天在宅邸中替冒險者進行試煉,然而結果總是令人失望。就在此時,被譽為期待新星的「淺垣燈悟」現身了。他那神秘又俐落的動作和姿勢究竟會展現出怎麼樣的實力?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #2
programme.desc: 與伊多拉締結羈絆的淺垣燈悟前往冒險者公會登錄戰隊。而就在這時,伊多拉卻遭到冒險者辱罵,因為她那位曾是王家之杖卻被稱為「膽小鬼」的父親。就在衝突一觸即發之際,燈悟竟提議要用任務來一決勝負?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #3
programme.desc: 阿瓦魯羅斯特帝國的王女「蒂露緹娜」及侍從「羅吉米斯特」前來拜訪。他們請伊多拉協助分析及回收「魔力之種」,但羅吉似乎不願讓燈悟同行。結果兩人竟要透過戰鬥展現各自的實力?

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #3
programme.desc: 以打架聞名的強者全聚集在一年一班。無視於一旁慌張的榆井及冷靜旁觀的蘇枋隼飛,櫻與被他惹怒的杉下京太郎展開了一場豪邁的戰鬥。但防風鈴的總長梅宮一高分貝的聲音打斷了他們的攻防。當櫻等人神情緊張地仰望著擴音器時,等到的卻是梅宮出乎意料的一番話。

香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#8粵
programme.desc: 有義頭頭碰著黑，相士蘇人中為他測出「狗離不得、雞碰不得」。有義認定福星瘟神正是有朋及溢滿。有義即對有朋獻殷勤，疏遠溢滿。有義後和盤托出實情，溢滿與有義以賽馬日「第九場九號」能否勝出作賭注，迫有義道歉。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#19粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘為了揭穿羅元娘的死與蓮房有關，不惜假懷孕，可惜事情露出馬腳，讓蓮房決定施計把十一娘趕走。令寬得知王煜與區勵行過從甚密，通知令宜，令宜聽從十一娘提議送令寬戲本以示獎勵, 十一娘對令宜更添好感。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 順德大良以飼養水牛聞名，以水牛奶做成的牛乳和雙皮奶，奶味尤其香濃。鼎爺帶阿譚見識手工牛乳的製作工序後「煮意」大發，巧製鮮甜滋味的「牛乳鯇片粥」，「自製鍋巴夾牛乳」則香脆可口。鍋巴怎樣才可炸得鬆化？阿譚手癢試炸，卻成了錯誤示範！「海南雞飯」雞滑、飯香，加上雞雜煮白菜湯，可謂完美配搭！鼎爺堅持選用新鮮黃薑入飯，它比黃薑粉有何優勝之處？此外，不論雪藏雞或冰鮮雞，均可煮出「鼎級」海南雞飯，關鍵又在哪裡？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老友記跌倒非同小可，由治療師、護士合作策劃與設計的「防跌舞」，為長者在生理上提升防跌能力之餘，還照顧其心理，從而減低他們的跌倒恐懼指數。相關計劃的代表示範防跌舞的多個基本動作，也會細說箇中的作用。灰甲是常見的都市病，困擾不少人士，如沒妥善處理，除了影響外觀，長遠還可引致更多健康問題。皮膚科醫生詳析治療方法，並提醒護理注意事項，以減少復發機會。「睇餸食飯」，Annie炮製暖笠笠菜式「臘味啫啫雞煲」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 馮盈盈與陳自瑤由鬥聲鬥到健康知識，今集來個血壓常識比拼！二人分別指出量血壓時的心境與姿勢要點，再由心臟科專科醫生補充與糾正；盈盈即場替自瑤量血壓，被醫生指唯一過錯是「騷擾」？甚麼不良生活習慣會導致高血壓？兩位副所長質疑自瑤的想法，自瑤為此更改答案，最後發現「中伏」！主動脈撕裂最常發生於身體甚麼位置？想控制血壓，飲食是其中一個要素，聽中醫介紹一款湯水，並了解當中的瑪卡和三七對控制血壓的功效。

programme.title: 陪著你走#1粵
programme.desc: 失明的宋天從由導盲犬「導生」引到商場，聽見廣告旁白，將片傳給男友杜正恆；推銷員將「愛是無所不能」天使匙扣給她。廣告創作總監甘言重想起三年前與好友余加勁宵夜之事。怕狗的言重離開便利店時卻遇上流浪狗……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子問媽媽的寶物是什麼，後者拿出年輕時買的蛋白石指環，並透露已經由3萬升值至100萬。小玉和藤木來到小丸子家看指環，然後用指環玩遊戲，此時媽媽突然回家，一陣混亂過後，指環不知所蹤。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 玲玲姐姐希望有一碗暖暖的湯圓，以陪伴她度過寒冷天氣，新到來「Artspiration」的繪畫��師答應她的要求，第一步是在紙上畫兩點再勾勒笑容？導師帶來非一般的畫湯圓教學，會在湯圓上繪出可愛笑臉，詳情怎樣？主持姐姐分享2026年的新目標，孩子們也投稿「開心SHARE」夢想職業。有小朋友提到想成為太空人，引發眾主持對太空的奇想，Tiffany姐姐更想過在太空中或許會出現另一個自己。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 今天偶像公主空間將舉行喵喵嘉年華。與此同時，小美頻道收到一個尋貓請求，根據網友消息，那貓貓還在樂園學園出現過。美月與陽葵繼而在校內尋貓，發現小學部的遊真舉止可疑，原來他在偷偷飼養一隻誤闖學校的貓咪。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 兩姊妹長大，單位空間也要重新劃分，設計師如何改動間隔，才能確保各自私隱，同時也有共享活動空間？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 西貢鹹田灣於除夕倒數後，遍地被遺棄帳篷及垃圾，公廁亦積存大量疑似排泄物，衛生情況欠佳。美甲店顧客遺留戒指，懷疑是下一手顧客偷走，店主卻無意協助？近期曾報道，大窩口某私人屋苑平台單位的業主備受樓上亂拋煙頭困擾。事主再聯絡節目組，談到事件的新進展。已婚婦在網上結識一位「機師」，要她代收財產物品，隨後被告知需繳交稅款及海關扣查費。套路似足過往情騙個案，女事主可會覺醒？中環海濱嘉年華回歸，這次有何特色？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2715粵
programme.desc: 尋寶圖實體店舉行年終特價傾銷活動，連帶網店營業額一同提升，怎料其後卻突然湧現退貨潮，原來內有隱情。樹根目睹有人大量退貨，也能取回全數貨款，遂肆無忌憚地瘋狂購物，怎料因璟風更改退貨條款而沒法退貨，不禁埋怨璟風，璟風只好設法「補償」。此時，樹根因瑞素成功退貨而得到啟發，想到一個可成功獲得退款的方法……因樹根之故，尋寶圖實體店退貨潮持續不斷，璟風此時提出一個讓眾人大感意外的決定……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#14粵PG
programme.desc: 何浩輝在辦公室收到一份神秘的生日禮物，打開後發現竟是與當年霍啟泉被炸死時一樣的電子手環，而且已經啟動，何浩輝和陳耀揚發瘋似的拿著快遞跑到樓下，卻發現手環並非炸彈，何浩輝與陳耀揚心領神會——周雄回來了。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#9粵普PG
programme.desc: 一笑想起曾聽到面具人提及給靜石送過一批銀兩，負責運送的是榮通鏢局，隨歌遂派人調查…一笑發現無影，追蹤她至死士營據點，無影正是當初訓練自己的死士營首領。無影欲殺一笑，一笑因聞到軟筋散渾身無力，命懸一線。

programme.title: MSIG iTravel Go 旅遊保險呈獻：塔斯曼尼亞潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 朗瑟士敦西面的壁畫小鎮，芷珮偶遇牽羊駝散步的伯伯，上前親暱合照。然後走進壁畫公園，成功跟陳奕迅、周柏豪的畫作合影。行逛朗瑟士敦著名的週六市集，受當地居民影響，芷珮忍不住以生蠔作早餐，大讚鮮美。往鬱金香花田打卡，芷珮於一望無際的花海中留倩影。再到松露農場探訪松露獵犬，並享用新鮮松露美食。來到塔斯西北部的沿海小鎮，芷珮登山俯瞰靚景，最後以海鮮大餐為行程劃上圓滿句號。品嚐比手掌更大的龍蝦，芷珮一臉滿足。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
名媛望族#14粵PG
programme.desc: 懿芳問爾嫣為何與卓萬疏遠，爾嫣沒回答，懿芳與她劃清界線。木水看見三爺對阿玉志在必得，鼓勵阿玉；為救阿玉木水付錢給麗姐作訂金。木水放火時被啟燁發現；警察把木水拘捕，達志責怪木水時，昇平指阿玉被提早開苞。

programme.title: 區區開伙粵
programme.desc: 在太子及大角咀「掃街」，吃盡各省各地特色美食。愛吃但不胖的蔡思貝，推介邪惡美食及甜品，還帶大家走入經典漫畫人物主題餐廳。主持一試街坊爆冷之選「東北菜」，並跟糖妹試勻韓國空運燒烤食材及西歐主菜美食！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬對遊牧民族的生活同文化來說是不可或缺的。蒙古人更把馬放在他們的傳統樂器上，製成雙弦樂器馬頭琴馬頭琴獨特的旋律不旦可以觸動動物的心靈, 也喚醒了蒙古人的身份認同，讓傳統文化得以傳承。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 羊角村，被譽為荷蘭威尼斯的美麗村落，早期居民在挖煤炭時，竟挖出大量山羊角，以此命名。社區以船代車，與水共生。泰國柯叻島，三百年前的人造島，早期是榴槤產地，經常引發洪災，榴槤種植難以為繼，轉型為陶瓷島。

programme.title: 西葡潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 最後一集，芷珮玩盡葡萄牙南部海岸阿爾加維！出海划雙人獨木舟，沿途穿梭海峽、細賞蔚藍海洋，探索別有洞天的岩石奇觀，她會遇上甚麼刺激事？參觀葡國有二千年歷史的古羅馬遺跡，順道在小型博物館，了解這所古老大宅的過去。到訪軟木製作工場，窺探有趣的打造過程，搜羅酒塞、羽毛球、家品、包包、雨傘等激罕軟木製品！芷珮駕着復古露營車，展開公路旅行，停泊在海灘靜待夕陽，在車上主理簡單晚餐，度過輕鬆愜意的一天。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 大澳水鄉別具風情，長沙水清沙幼，風景宜人。陸浩明、許嘉傑、歐陽巧瑩、容羨媛嘗試從「立體」角度出發，欣賞不一樣的大嶼山風光。沿著虎山山脊拾級而上，大澳蔚藍海景一覽無遺；登上舢舨穿梭於棚屋之間，浪漫感覺媲美到訪歐洲威尼斯；置身於舊警署改建而成的文物酒店，可細味源自上世紀初的懷舊氣息；入住海邊主題民宿，足不出戶也可細賞鬧市難得一見的潮汐日落景色。幾位主持還來到沙灘大玩衝浪，散發青春活力。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 室內設計是指透過改善建築物內部的藝術與科學，為使用者營造更健康、更美觀的環境。谷主瀅仴詳述多種設計風格的特色，其中某種強調「少即是多」的概念，會是甚麼風格？還有近年新興的「侘寂風格」，其主張的「不完美的美」又是何意？谷主汛文公開其在加拿大的家居照片，並分享由媽媽設計的工業風地庫。眾谷主又淺談設計時應否為未來可能的需求預留空間，各有甚麼想法？瀅仴笑言數年後或會有結婚打算，因而被拍檔打趣調侃。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 勁歌金榜粵
programme.desc: 許文軒為觀眾倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」二十首上榜歌曲的排名位置，並相約歌手谷婭溦暢談音樂。

programme.title: 三餸一湯粵
programme.desc: 三姐帶來蓮藕兩食，先煲「蓮藕綠豆乳鴿湯」，蓮藕節、皮部位的營養尤其豐富；另將蓮藕切件，用南乳混腐乳燜煮，然後炸至金黃色，配合香炸薑絲做出「金絲蓮藕」。三姐燜蓮藕時特別加入紅麴米，有何作用？「味菜雞柳燴魚肚」匯聚焦香雞肉與開胃味菜，三姐在蝦膠「加料」，令口感更爽脆。緊接三姐傳授新鮮豬皮的處理方法，經過火燒、汆水、切花的步驟，再釀入墨魚膠和雞蓉先煎後蒸；以上湯、蛋白調製琉璃芡，這道「釀豬皮」甚考功夫！

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 招浩明請嘉賓伍詠薇用嘴加持，帶來換啤牌魔術；再與觀眾互動，展現神奇預知能力！陳乙僮獻唱<黃色大門用錯發聲位，獲嘉賓蔡一傑傳授歌唱貼士。姜嘉琳送上歌舞劇表演，卻被評咬字不清，能否過關？挫敗也可成追夢契機，前空姐吳洛汶實現台上唱歌的心願，盼藉<逃生門感動大家。入行多年的黃建東，仍有一團演藝火，冀以鋼琴彈唱、Rap唱獲得認同。繆家慶同樣自彈自唱，透過抵死創作<陽過訴說「中招隔離」心聲，笑住抗疫！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 腫瘤科醫生莫樹錦接受壓力程度測試，得分竟然是0！讓他最感壓力的會是哪一刻？莫醫生還抱有一個「奇怪」的人生觀，這是壓力零分的心得嗎？壓力可引致痛症，在脊醫指引下進行空罐測試及肩關節痛症幅度測試，簡單舉手即可測出肩膊狀況。按摩時配合香薰精油，也有舒緩功效，留意香薰治療師的複方建議。氣味能夠掀起人的回憶，並影響情緒，臨床心理學家帶來四款物品，讓主持透過嗅覺放鬆一陣。此外，從偏好的氣味，更可測出壓力來源？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 後空翻少年粵日
programme.desc: 初中最後一個夏天，雙葉翔太郎偶然認識了男子韻律體操這項運動，不覺被它深深吸引。翌年，雙葉入讀私立蒼秀館高中，並向男子韻律體操隊叩門，這裡不但有一眾別具個性的前輩，還有與他同年的初中體操明星美里良夜。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 久坐對身體不好，既然功課做完了，不妨跟兒童體適能教練一同動起來！先做深蹲及「無影櫈」動作，考驗大家的下肢肌耐力。地上放一個雪糕筒，利用核心肌群發力，提起腳部跨過雪糕筒；如想增加穩定度，可試試叉腰做。最後加上原地跳練習，第一階段訓練就可完成。休息過後，輪到針對柔軟度的運動。坐於瑜伽墊上，先將雙腳伸直，嘗試彎腰讓雙手碰到腳尖，再做扭腰、蝴蝶式、雙手扣緊向外拉、大字伸展等動作，看看誰人要改善柔軟度？

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 眼見讓風力發電廠將要運作時，竟突然發生雪崩，令發電廠瞬間毀壞。幸好還有一個方法，就是潮汐發電。可是礙於潮汐的特性，一天就只有兩次機會。智悟堅定決心，矢志終結大停電，奪回光明的世界。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 天氣轉冷，外面有小販車出售煨番薯。小丸子滿心歡喜拉爺爺外出購買，爺爺卻忘記帶銀包，令小丸子與煨番薯緣慳一面。小丸子對此事耿耿於懷，翌日上學也談起這件事，豬太郎則說那架小販車會在某處定時出現……

programme.title: 榮寶齋粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦榮寶齋代代堅守、薪火相傳的百年歷程，透過榮寶齋這一中國文化與藝術發展的重要縮影，展現中國傳統文化的魅力與蓬勃的生命力。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
香港中旅集團呈獻：新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 女神玩轉嘉年華粵
programme.desc: 五對「女神」CP重聚，盡情玩轉遊戲。坐上海盜船，俊其要用水槍射甩毓儀臉上的紫菜，卻一味尖叫？展望「尊重遊戲」瘋狂掃射、焌堯釋放野獸一面，水柱分別衝擊蒨文、芷晴的美貌。男士矇眼自轉，以指定器皿倒水進女神頭上水杯，表達「520」心聲。嘉敏被家俊以「瀑布」淋頭，一直叫停都無用……揀中超長嘴水壺一組，可謂地獄級難度！輪到女神矇眼玩遊戲，敏巧鯨吞啟進身上的車厘子，玩到「吐血」；某男笑得開懷，恍如自肥時間？

programme.title: 無雙粵PG
programme.desc: 偽鈔集團神秘首腦一手挖掘落魄畫家李問加入自己的偽鈔團隊,用高超的造假技術製作出真假難辨的偽鈔,引起警方高度重視然而,神秘首腦和其他成員的身份一直成謎,警方的破案進度遭受了前所未有的挑戰

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 2025年本港舉行了不少國際級盛事，還首次與廣東、澳門聯合承辦全運會，加上啟德體育園正式啟用，為體育界掀起新一頁，這集回顧香港體壇大事。香港馬拉松將於1月18日舉行，大會推行「助小店撐跑手」計劃，邀全港多區餐飲食店參與，冀將盛事經濟帶動至社區，同時為跑手打氣。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 中信股份呈獻：財經透視粵
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 新鮮人#23粵
programme.desc: Raymond再插莊嫁禍家輝，家輝苦無證據，唯有忍痛將心血賣給志遠的財團。麗華找Raymond求情被戲弄，時楊定中出現替她出頭，原來自家輝裝修後便風山水起，他一直希望報答。家輝突然向麗華示愛，麗華不知所措。志遠、少嫻上門找家輝傾談合作，少嫻見浩浩之頸鏈，即斷定她是失散的女兒。家謙本準備陪韋文倒數生日，阮盈卻突然出現，稱患上絕症。韋文一直等家謙，惜再次失望。家謙陪伴病重的阮盈，阮盈感動。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 大澳水鄉別具風情，長沙水清沙幼，風景宜人。陸浩明、許嘉傑、歐陽巧瑩、容羨媛嘗試從「立體」角度出發，欣賞不一樣的大嶼山風光。沿著虎山山脊拾級而上，大澳蔚藍海景一覽無遺；登上舢舨穿梭於棚屋之間，浪漫感覺媲美到訪歐洲威尼斯；置身於舊警署改建而成的文物酒店，可細味源自上世紀初的懷舊氣息；入住海邊主題民宿，足不出戶也可細賞鬧市難得一見的潮汐日落景色。幾位主持還來到沙灘大玩衝浪，散發青春活力。

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 招浩明請嘉賓伍詠薇用嘴加持，帶來換啤牌魔術；再與觀眾互動，展現神奇預知能力！陳乙僮獻唱<黃色大門用錯發聲位，獲嘉賓蔡一傑傳授歌唱貼士。姜嘉琳送上歌舞劇表演，卻被評咬字不清，能否過關？挫敗也可成追夢契機，前空姐吳洛汶實現台上唱歌的心願，盼藉<逃生門感動大家。入行多年的黃建東，仍有一團演藝火，冀以鋼琴彈唱、Rap唱獲得認同。繆家慶同樣自彈自唱，透過抵死創作<陽過訴說「中招隔離」心聲，笑住抗疫！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 腫瘤科醫生莫樹錦接受壓力程度測試，得分竟然是0！讓他最感壓力的會是哪一刻？莫醫生還抱有一個「奇怪」的人生觀，這是壓力零分的心得嗎？壓力可引致痛症，在脊醫指引下進行空罐測試及肩關節痛症幅度測試，簡單舉手即可測出肩膊狀況。按摩時配合香薰精油，也有舒緩功效，留意香薰治療師的複方建議。氣味能夠掀起人的回憶，並影響情緒，臨床心理學家帶來四款物品，讓主持透過嗅覺放鬆一陣。此外，從偏好的氣味，更可測出壓力來源？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬對遊牧民族的生活同文化來說是不可或缺的。蒙古人更把馬放在他們的傳統樂器上，製成雙弦樂器馬頭琴馬頭琴獨特的旋律不旦可以觸動動物的心靈, 也喚醒了蒙古人的身份認同，讓傳統文化得以傳承。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 羊角村，被譽為荷蘭威尼斯的美麗村落，早期居民在挖煤炭時，竟挖出大量山羊角，以此命名。社區以船代車，與水共生。泰國柯叻島，三百年前的人造島，早期是榴槤產地，經常引發洪災，榴槤種植難以為繼，轉型為陶瓷島。

programme.title: 區區開伙粵
programme.desc: 在太子及大角咀「掃街」，吃盡各省各地特色美食。愛吃但不胖的蔡思貝，推介邪惡美食及甜品，還帶大家走入經典漫畫人物主題餐廳。主持一試街坊爆冷之選「東北菜」，並跟糖妹試勻韓國空運燒烤食材及西歐主菜美食！

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 麥長青帶同檸檬汁，說要去除依附在地毯上的頑固紅酒漬，牆上的筆漬又怎樣去除？不同品牌的啤酒樽蓋也有21個鋸齒，此數字有甚麼玄機？啤酒有特異功能，可在植物及人頭上起作用！巧妙折曲衣架，輕易變身萬用掛架！

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 冰凍汽水人人愛，忘了把汽水放雪櫃？來一盆冰水，30秒便可「急凍」它！飲料倒出來有時會濺得滿桌都是，掌握簡單技巧便輕鬆解決。女士也可極速換燈膽、鑽牆兼不傷手？留意香香示範！倒數小小麵包袋夾的實用五強。

programme.title: 成長吧！大熊貓粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦中國大熊貓保護研究中心四川臥龍神樹坪基地2021年新生的四隻熊貓寶寶及它們的飼養員們，以“視頻日記”的記錄方式，以全外景拍攝熊貓寶寶的成長過程。

programme.title: 成長吧！大熊貓粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦中國大熊貓保護研究中心四川臥龍神樹坪基地2021年新生的四隻熊貓寶寶及它們的飼養員們，以“視頻日記”的記錄方式，以全外景拍攝熊貓寶寶的成長過程。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 讓星夢頻道偶像就不同課題一決高下，最後與鳳凰蒙面俠爭勝的鳳凰盃緊急開賽。當賽事進入決賽階段，奇蹟閃耀組、Meltic StAr、Ring Marry要就鳳凰這個題目創作藝術作品，但各自藝術觀的不同，令她們在構思之際費煞思量。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 頂尖星夢頻道偶像白鳥杏樹回歸閃亮宿，為了跟大家加深感情，更想親力親為舉辦一場面具舞會，多得未來等人幫忙，繁重的準備工作也順利完成。舞會當晚，就在大家樂在其中之際，竟有個鬼鬼祟祟的人影在會場內移動……

programme.title: 愛犬訊號粵日
programme.desc: 小山田先生退休後，妻子向他提出離婚，家中只剩英國古代牧羊犬絲帶與他相依為命。小山田盡力與絲帶建立關係，但是去狗狗公園遊玩時，卻發現絲帶動作變得緩慢，反應也有些遲鈍，繼而找上丹羽和未祐求助。

programme.title: 愛犬訊號粵日
programme.desc: 律佳的寵物美容店聘請了一個兼職，她就是立志成為寵物美容師的專科學生東山繪麻。繪麻在一個半月前收養了一隻積羅素爹利隆太，可是隆太精力過剩，頻頻弄壞家中物品，令繪麻相當困擾，惟有向律佳請教。

programme.title: 出走澳洲粵
programme.desc: 來到大型朱古力店，翠如、永城不怕健康超標，盡情品嚐朱古力火鍋。馳名餅店有售多元化口味的餡餅，永城享用足料「周打蜆湯批」，卻勾起昔日被整蠱的經歷！二人及後隨古董車車主「遊車河」，並欣賞沿途風光。翠如、永城前赴袋鼠島尋找青春，坐在海邊慢活嘆咖啡，絕對是一大享受。置身露營營地生火燒烤，永城想起甚麼年少漆黑玩意，竟然「紅都面晒」？國家公園內有不少奇岩怪石，「致青春」的翠如、永城還會細訴想要告別的童年遺憾。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 先進烹調技術能幫助大家「因慢得快」！肥媽示範以慢煮棒炮製經典豉油雞，方法簡單而香嫩依然。運用「炸」與「炒」兩種方法炮製多寶魚，既可物盡其用，並帶來不同口感。由阿媽煮理的「鴛鴦藍蟹粥」，滋味足可媲美遠近馳名的澳門風味。煮靚粥除了講求用料新鮮，洗米後「雪米」更是煲出綿滑蟹粥的秘技。肥媽還送上「沙茶金菇牛肉煲」，惹味非常！肥媽貼心推介「薑黃奶」，讓女士們舒緩每月週期不適；並快煮健康甜品「腰果藜麥奶露」。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽搜購急凍沙甸魚替代罐頭產品，並以半煎炸方式帶來「葡萄牙沙甸魚」。阿媽細心為6號拆走魚骨，還親手將「足料」彈牙的「素鮑片蝦膠蒸蘆筍」餵進其口中，6號大感窩心！花蟹、木瓜配搭新穎，滾煮成鮮甜的「花蟹木瓜湯」，可謂一湯兩食佳品。肥媽以光波爐炮製肉質幼嫩的「西班牙黑毛豬叉燒」，讓人一試難忘。另外，6號推介「黑豆水」，除有美白、抗衰老功效，亦適合減肥人士飲用。「煮好D 快DD」環節則示範「蘿蔔清湯腩」。

programme.title: 令人心動的OFFER普
programme.desc: 節目走進香港律政體系和大律師職業，由數位來自不同背景、懷抱夢想的法學生在帶教大律師的引領下，經歷為期一月的實習生活。他們通過圍繞普通法和大陸法兩大法系設計的八大課題考驗，爭奪兩個成為大律師的offer。

programme.title: 到此一遊 台北粵
programme.desc: 區永權引領陳敏之前往距離台北市中心約一小時車程的露營區，預先體驗台式親子樂趣。二人又到訪佈滿遊樂設施的酒店，家庭房更加設帳幕，小朋友想必喜歡。以電競為主題的酒吧，客人可一邊打機一邊交流，而店內飲品亦注入電玩元素。若嫌電競沒有真實感，不妨考慮試玩真人競技。Albert手持劍盾、敏之拿着弓箭，對戰一觸即發。被敏之稱為考驗友情的一碗麵，究竟是甚麼玩法？看見老闆端上巨碗，Albert隨即目瞪口呆！

programme.title: 後空翻少年粵日
programme.desc: 人生初次成功做出後空翻的翔太郎，決心加入男子韻律體操隊。為加深團隊默契，翔太郎更要與其他隊員在同一個宿舍共同生活。隨著翔太郎與美里的加入，男子韻律體操隊終於有六個隊員，並準備以齊人姿態挑戰團體賽。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 歌手羅啟豪到來「My Little Show」，藉着一曲<小鬼主意，向小朋友傳遞滿滿正能量。六位女孩子則以芭蕾舞演繹北極熊在冰川上嬉戲的情境，既歡樂又可愛。此外，主持姐姐和結他導師一同合唱<愛護大自然、<世界的心跳，透過歌聲宣揚愛護自然環境的訊息。導師亦會介紹一款十二弦結他，與一般的六弦結他相比，彈奏出的聲音有甚麼特色？「AI小學堂」，老師帶來利用運算思維向AI提問的技巧。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 藤木因為在公園不小心弄亂了別人以橡子砌的圖形，因此以葉片留下訊息道歉。第二天，藤木發現對方留言回應了。爺爺因為多次答錯電視問答節目的問題，而被小丸子認為爺爺的說話不可信。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 榮寶齋粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦榮寶齋代代堅守、薪火相傳的百年歷程，透過榮寶齋這一中國文化與藝術發展的重要縮影，展現中國傳統文化的魅力與蓬勃的生命力。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 網購熱潮下自提點湧現，當中不乏零售小商的參與，他們都想以兼營自提點的方式，補貼現時入不敷支的本業生意；部分創業人士也瞄準商機，乘勢開辦多間自提點，冀求獲利。有經濟學者指出，自提點遍地開花，反映本地經濟結構正逐步轉變，而未來網購會進一步打擊本地零售商舖的生意。與此同時，自提點經營者也需要面對自提櫃、上門送貨等競爭，到底他們有多大生存空間？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 澳娛綜合呈獻：萬千星輝頒獎典禮2025粵
programme.desc: 2025台慶頒獎禮各獎項即將揭盅！三部台慶劇《新聞女王2》、《金式森林》、《巨塔之后》成大獎強力競爭者，「最佳劇集」榮歸何處？「視后」之爭激烈，佘詩曼、宣萱、李施嬅屬熱門人選。郭晉安、林保怡力爭再膺「視帝」，黃宗澤、羅子溢亦可望首度封王。「男、女配」龔慈恩、高海寧、王敏奕、蔣祖曼、姜大衞、徐榮、何廣沛、丁子朗等各有支持者，誰能突圍？黃庭鋒、陳浚霆、曾展望、戴祖儀、葉蒨文、關嘉敏則「飛躍」呼聲較高。

programme.title: 澳娛綜合呈獻：萬千星輝頒獎典禮2025 王者盛典粵
programme.desc: 《萬千星輝頒獎典禮2025》圓滿舉行，得獎名單終極鎖定。一路走來的努力和付出，換來獎項認同與觀眾肯定，眾出爐「王者」定必體會尤深！緊接頒獎禮，主持許文軒隨即送上祝賀，誠邀「最佳劇集」、「最佳男、女主角」、「最佳男、女配角」、「大灣區最喜愛TVB男、女主角」等獎項得主，共聚「王者盛典」，細訴獲獎喜悅與深刻點滴。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
新鮮人#24粵
programme.desc: 家輝應麗華所求用最老套方法向她求婚。家輝舊老板終在報章刊登對家輝道歉啟事，家輝多年冤屈終於得償。阮盈再度不辭而別，留信給家謙稱並無絕症。家謙遇DY得悉阮盈患病真相，DY更透露內心世界，勸家謙珍惜眼前人。鋼琴大師艾絲坦即將來港，漸秀要家謙勤加練習，答應會推薦他。機場內，阮盈寫完給韋文的信後瞌然而逝。韋文決意離港流浪，家謙趕不及留住她。唱婆突康復，感激麗華對她十幾年來照顧，可惜只是迴光反照。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 大師級大觀園粵英
programme.desc: 本節目製作單位與國際頂級博物館和藝廊合作，以沉浸式電影加上具代表性的歷史學家和藝評家的講解，讓觀眾觀賞世界知名的藝術作品。

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，了解最偉大科學家的生活，了解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.title: 西葡潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 最後一集，芷珮玩盡葡萄牙南部海岸阿爾加維！出海划雙人獨木舟，沿途穿梭海峽、細賞蔚藍海洋，探索別有洞天的岩石奇觀，她會遇上甚麼刺激事？參觀葡國有二千年歷史的古羅馬遺跡，順道在小型博物館，了解這所古老大宅的過去。到訪軟木製作工場，窺探有趣的打造過程，搜羅酒塞、羽毛球、家品、包包、雨傘等激罕軟木製品！芷珮駕着復古露營車，展開公路旅行，停泊在海灘靜待夕陽，在車上主理簡單晚餐，度過輕鬆愜意的一天。

programme.title: 美食一條街 順德篇粵
programme.desc: 順德覓食之旅，由大良華蓋路步行街開始，大良燉奶有新花款，鄺潔楹對「首創」亦有新定義！倫教糕即白糖糕，加蛋煎製又有何新火花？拜訪順德網紅名廚，「魚羊鮮」和「岳母雞」令人難忘；走進由機械人主理的火鍋店，落單、送餐、甜品製作全智能化，眼界大開！還有另類「水晶料理」，莫非要把水晶吞入口中？即叫即燒的炭火燒雞與燒排骨，遠近馳名，三位哈比女主持都給予高評價。旅程尾聲一嚐混入黑米的煲仔飯，最讓人驚喜的卻是價格！

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉和丈夫恩範已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因恩範外遇出軌導致離婚收場。荷拉時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 人氣封鎖中:UserNotFound
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同時作為轉學生的機率，是旼財意想不到的巧合。與作為人氣女王敏在協議交換身份生活，原本逐漸透明的生活開始畫上色彩。隨著時間害怕被拆穿，同時只在敏在面前直率的申義俊，在他的陪伴與守護找到自我。

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: SOS！小仙女曼曼(完)
programme.desc: 在魔法王國，不論是穿不下玻璃鞋、被三隻小豬欺負，還是遇到壞女巫，只要大喊「SOS！小仙女曼曼」，小仙女曼曼就會用雨傘魔杖為你解決問題！

programme.title: 南瓜入侵
programme.desc: 麥克原本擁有完美又快樂的生活，直到意外發現家裡剛收養的孩子，竟然是打算入侵地球的南瓜星人！於是聯合同學塞爾、科學家西蒙、酷女孩萊特，試圖阻止南瓜星人的入侵計畫！

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 南瓜入侵
programme.desc: 麥克原本擁有完美又快樂的生活，直到意外發現家裡剛收養的孩子，竟然是打算入侵地球的南瓜星人！於是聯合同學塞爾、科學家西蒙、酷女孩萊特，試圖阻止南瓜星人的入侵計畫！

programme.title: 豆小鴨
programme.desc: 單純直率的豆小鴨總是不小心闖禍，還好他有最棒的好朋友－－善解人意的袋熊沃蓓，和熱愛發明的小豬奇姆！只要三個人在一起，不管遇到任何困難，都能運用創意找到有趣的方法解決，把日常生活的所有危機，變成精彩好玩的大冒險！快快快，一起來山谷洞玩吧！

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎(完)
programme.desc: 專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉和丈夫恩範已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因恩範外遇出軌導致離婚收場。荷拉時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 人氣封鎖中:UserNotFound(完)
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同時作為轉學生的機率，是旼財意想不到的巧合。與作為人氣女王敏在協議交換身份生活，原本逐漸透明的生活開始畫上色彩。隨著時間害怕被拆穿，同時只在敏在面前直率的申義俊，在他的陪伴與守護找到自我。

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟
programme.desc: 【《高斯電子公司》裴賢聖不當高富帥，與《精神教練諸葛吉》鄭宇奇蹟相遇】負債累累的熱血青年陸東柱，在以為是人生中最糟糕的一天遇上了特殊神力卻來歷不明名為「奇蹟」的少年。能夠深刻感受別人痛苦與絕望，也能治癒別人。為找回他的過去與記憶，兩人成為了彼此生命中的一個奇蹟相遇。

programme.title: Homicide Unit Istanbul: Thailand (2)
programme.desc: With his colleague’s life on the line, Inspector Mehmet has to bust Thai crime boss Worawit out of jail. But an ambush by the Red Dragon gang leaves Worawit kidnapped and Mehmet injured and semi-conscious. How will Mehmet save his colleague now?

programme.title: From The Vine
programme.desc: A burnt-out executive experiences an ethical crisis and travels back to his hometown in rural Italy to recalibrate his moral compass.

programme.title: Home Front
programme.desc: Called up to fight in the Algerian war in 1960, four veterans are forced to confront their past more than forty years after they have returned to France. Despite keeping silent all this while, small events spark painful memories of their untold stories.

programme.title: The Second
programme.desc: An author's success following the release of her celebrated erotic memoir is threatened when her best friend and muse reveals the truth behind the memoir's provenance, igniting an incendiary tale of sex, lies and betrayal.

programme.title: Jeanny: The Fifth Girl
programme.desc: In a picturesque tiny town near Vienna, young girls have been vanishing without a trace for years. Jeanny has just fallen in love with a mysterious man. But when she notices signs of a dark side in him, she becomes suspicious. Will she be the next victim?

programme.title: Veins Of The World
programme.desc: After his father dies in a tragic car accident, 11-year-old Amra sets out to continue his father’s vision of the traditional nomad way of life and to continue his fight against global mining companies who threaten to destroy it.

programme.title: Homicide Unit Istanbul: Decisions In Athens
programme.desc: Inspector Mehmet goes on an unofficial assignment abroad to help his ex-wife Sevim to track down her missing partner Steffen, an investigative journalist, and his kidnapped daughter Clara in the Greek capital Athens.

programme.title: Joy Of Fatherhood
programme.desc: Felix enjoys his single life to the fullest, but a ferret bites him, sterilizing him in the process. He tries everything in his power to find the soon-to-be mother of his only child, the result of his first and last sperm donation.

programme.title: Sofia
programme.desc: In Morocco, sex outside marriage is punishable by up to 12 months in prison. But when unmarried Sofia gives birth, her family’s biggest fear is not her going to jail, it’s preserving their honour.

programme.title: Roise & Frank
programme.desc: Recently widowed Róise is struggling with her grief following her husband's passing. However, when a stray dog starts to follow her around, she starts to believe that it might be the reincarnation of her husband.

programme.title: A Minute's Silence
programme.desc: In a small Baltic town, 18-year-old Christian and his teacher Stella fall for one another and begin a secret affair. However, the intensity of their feelings soon overwhelm them. When tragedy befalls Stella, Christian is forced to confront his first love.

programme.title: Aurora (2019)
programme.desc: Aurora, a commitment-phobic party animal, meets Iranian Darian one night at a hot-dog stand in Lapland. Darian is running from death and Aurora is running from love. They need each other to finally stop running.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma's pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily found help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques.

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hung's relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhou's favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: In this period martial arts thriller, three police graduates are assigned to a town rife with crimes and corruption. They vow to uphold justice but are hampered by their corrupt superior, resulting in them putting their lives and the lives of their beloved in danger.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow" is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar "Drunken Cat" who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: Model from Hell
programme.desc: Anna, an exceptional student in a modelling school, becomes the target of envy from fellow models, who all die mysteriously when they want to harm her. It turns out that when Anna is upset, she undergoes a terrifying transformation and can wield lethal psychic power...

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: The Gambling Ghost
programme.desc: Sammo Hung plays three roles: Fatty, Fatty's father and grandfather. Hoping to become rich, hotel staff Fatty dives into gambling with his friend to the dismay of his father. When Fatty hits rock bottom, his grandfather's ghost appears to help him. As Fatty finds out that his grandfather was murdered, he vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: Don't Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP35
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP4
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP20
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: STEP INTO THE PAST, A - EP1
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP48
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: Class of Distinction - EP20
programme.desc: Hong Kong superstar Leon Lai joins forces with many friends in the entertainment industry to star in the TVB drama "Good Morning Sir," playing a passionate and energetic young teacher who experiences unique challenges in school, family, and relationships.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP13
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP3
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP36
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP5
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP21
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP2
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP50
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.
